Street Tally pilot, version {version}

Street Tally helps you check the places around you for a local campaign and put what you find on OpenStreetMap. This build is for the Woodbine entrance doors pilot.

## Install

1. Download `street-tally.apk` below and open the file.
2. If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps, then tap Install.
3. Go back to the campaign page and tap Open this campaign.

No OpenStreetMap account needed to start. Questions: https://streettally.osm.lol/faq · Privacy: https://streettally.osm.lol/privacy
